C.original_inverse_input: E(r)=max{1,(1+5r)/6}; it is an input to the zero-density/prime-moment branch, not an improved inverse output.
coefficient_restrictions: prime coefficients with fixed smooth profiles
bounded number of independently weighted prime factors
every prime factor norm >=Y^c for fixed c>0
C.scale_restriction: Printed convolution theorem has row norm ~Y and coefficient product norm ~Y; target row U and column U^r is unbalanced.
C.Mobius_support_counter_observation: For a fixed allowed prime ideal p0 outside finite S, squarefree products p0*q occur at arbitrarily large column scales. Their Mobius coefficient is nonzero but p0 is eventually smaller than Y^c for every fixed c>0; they lie outside the theorem class.
C.illustrative_optimistic_rescaling: Even pretending one can set Y=D while changing the row scale, normalization by D gives r*(kappa6-1), exceeding 1/5+4r/5 by more than 6683/60000 over the requested band.
